control_profile: Symmetric twenty-percent volatility target only; position stops, cooldowns, drawdown brakes, time stops, and turnover clipping are disabled.
falsifier: Reject selective funding-event pruning if the 0.75/1.50 z thresholds do not reduce turnover and raise gross edge density relative to the 0.50/1.25 center while preserving annualized return, both sleeve roles, regimes, and stressed-cost robustness.
formation_horizon: latest settled funding event standardized against forty-two prior events, requiring absolute z of 0.75 with three-bar unwind confirmation or 1.50 in chop
hypothesis: The freshest three/seven-day funding-unwind construction contains positive gross PnL but admits marginal funding events; stronger 0.75/1.50 z thresholds should prune low-edge churn without diluting signal timing.
rebalance_horizon: daily cohorts with three-day confirmed-unwind and seven-day chop-extreme shadow portfolios
